implementation.authority: The model may return only world name, summary, hero name/origin, two character descriptions, locations and lore text. Python maps that source to a fixed schema-v3 three-chapter/choice/Flag/relationship-event/route/ending skeleton, validates it, and the only write remains worlds:compose.
implementation.draft_lifecycle: AIWorldDraft is an API response only. It has no table, no draft id and no persisted state; cancellation has zero aggregate writes.
implementation.content: Generated cards are native character_cards with controlled mapped fields and export as chara_card_v3. Generated lore is lorebook content and uses the existing World Info exporter.

verification.contract_tests: 56 backend tests and Ruff passed. Added coverage proves generation has zero World/WorldVersion/Hero/Run/compose-request rows before confirmation, rejects unknown source fields including commands, handles model failure and invalid review edits without a write, projects all three requested rulesets, reaches a Python good ending after three choices, rolls back, and makes a native generated card export as V3.
verification.real_huihui_confirmed_play: A second real Huihui draft was explicitly confirmed through worlds:compose, then three real narrated choice turns reached lan-dawn. A rollback to the first turn produced revision 4, active ch2 and ending=null. The isolated integrity scan reported every orphan class as zero.
verification.source_browser_review: A local Vite browser connected to the isolated Host selected the Huihui profile and generated a real valid draft. The review page exposed the summary plus editable WorldDefinition/Hero fields. Changing hero.name immediately disabled confirmation until the edited JSON was revalidated; a valid revalidation restored confirmation and showed the schema-v3/narrative success alert. Cancelling returned to World Center with the explicit zero-write notice and no additional World/Run. A previous source-browser pass explicitly confirmed a valid draft and showed the generated World Info count and both native generated cards with V3 export actions.

boundary: This is API plus real-model evidence, not a packaged Mac review/edit keyboard/screen-reader journey or a real card export/import UI round trip. It therefore records no maturity score delta. Android gameplay-only scope and all release gates remain unchanged.
